records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue increased by $54.6 million, or 65.4%, to $138.3 million from $83.7 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The effect of this change was to accelerate $67.8 million of deferred revenue into the first quarter of fiscal year 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating margin increased 44.7 percentage points to 42.3% from negative 2.4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities was $2.8 million, a net change of $0.7 million from cash used in operating activities of $2.1 million.
